meta.source: Page registry. URLs and intents from docs/STRATEGY.md §2 (Keyword Map).
meta.notes: One entry per URL. status: live = indexable, in sitemap and hubs; draft = page exists but noindex, not in sitemap or hubs; planned = no page is created. Only the owner's OK moves a page to live (CLAUDE.md §8). type picks the template: home, utility, hub, tool, article. Body lives in content/<slug>.php (home uses content/home.php). group (articles only) picks the section on /guides; sections follow meta.articleGroups. problems (tools only) lists troubleshooting slugs shown as 'Common problems' in the What to do next box; problemLabel is the short anchor used there. A slug with "/" is a child page under the slug before it (state cost pages: water-heater-installation-cost/<state>), synced as a WordPress child page; template "state-cost" renders it with templates/state-cost.php and content/water-heater-installation-cost-state.php, and state is its two-letter code in data/state-pages.json.
